title: ETA cross-fade on tick
description: EXPLORATORY — when a row's countdown number changes value on a poll (e.g. '3 min' -> '2 min'), the digit would cross-fade rather than snap. Demonstrated on the mini-board as a looping soft opacity fade on one ETA value, standing in for a value change.
warning: app/pages/index.vue deliberately uses a plain re-render, not TransitionGroup, because a promoted SALIENDO row (index 0) FLIP-animating over another row rendered two trips' text in the same space. Do not implement without solving that.

changes.intent: Detect a change in the row's own eta value between polls (independent of row identity/position) and play a brief cross-fade on just the number, not the whole row.
changes.detail: Would need a watcher on the eta prop per row keyed by trip_id, toggling a short-lived CSS class to trigger the fade — deliberately scoped to avoid re-triggering row-level transitions, since the row-level transition path is exactly what's blocked by the warning above (index-0 SALIENDO promotion colliding with any FLIP/enter-leave transition on the list).
